summary.text: Robert Duvall is a Republican state representative who has represented Kentucky House of Representatives District 17 since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An optometrist and business owner, he earned his doctorate in optometry from the University of Alabama at Birmingham.

paragraphs.text: Robert Duvall earned a doctorate in optometry from the University of Alabama at Birmingham in 1995.
His career experience includes owning Precision Eye Care & Optical and Drs. Duvall, Tade, & Associates and working as an optometrist with Doctor's ValuVision.
He has been affiliated with the Kentucky Optometric Association, the American Optometric Association, and the Bowling Green Chamber of Commerce.
Duvall took office in the Kentucky House on January 1, 2023, as the successor to Steve Sheldon.

For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Banking and Insurance, Economic Development and Workforce Investment, and Committee on Families and Children committees and was vice chair of the Health and Family Services Committee.
The Republican primary for his seat on May 19, 2026, was canceled.
